summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of $107M aggregate principal amount of 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes due 2031. The notes bear interest at 7.50% payable semi-annually, mature June 15, 2031, and are convertible into ordinary shares at an initial conversion price of approximately $25.4826 per share (39.2425 shares per $1,000 principal). Placement agents Benchmark and StoneX Financial will receive a 4.1355% fee. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Offering mechanics include no escrow, no minimum, and senior unsecured ranking. Watch for dilution risk and conversion dynamics given Nasdaq-listed shares traded at $21.78 on June 2, 2026.
